prompt: Animate this exact hand-drawn Japanese gothic anime frame. Preserve ink contours, hard-edged cel shadows, matte skin and painted architecture; no CGI, photoreal rendering, orbit, random zoom, extra limbs, costume change or unrelated cut. GPT stands beside the fallen priest in her single restored human form. She looks down at his face, holding one short cold assessing beat, then shifts her gaze to the belt. She bends one knee and lowers herself to reach toward his waist. Her two membranous wings fold closer to her back, one tail stays low and clear of him. End before the fingers touch the key, for a clean cut to the detail. Controlled low camera follows the descent slightly; no victory pose, smile, duplicate GPT or costume change.
